_comment: The PC node (#145, option A: the owner's Windows gaming PC as a model server, not an execution host). Add this node to the provider host's git-ignored tables/resources.json, beside the Pro (tables/resources.example.json). Kept in its own file so the fleet example stays as it is. Addresses and the token path come from the env vars named below, set in the provider's LaunchAgent; never commit them. Runbook: docs/runbooks/PC-RTX3060-ENROLLMENT.md, section 12.

nodes._comment: target null: not sampled over ssh (WSL is gone, and the fleet sampler does not gate the local lane); the probe through its gate is its health check. The gate serves only while the owner is away from the PC and the manual switch is on (node_policy windows-idle on the PC); local_switch with node "pc" flips the switch.

ollama._comment: The block name is historical: a gate-fronted Anthropic node. Pin-only (owner 2026-11-24): auto_route and index_route false, so S1 never auto-picks it until the owner sets a proxy-index deduction (tables/local-models.json, index_proxies.not_mapped). The model is configuration: models[].id must equal served_model_name in the PC's local-backend.json (tables/local-backend.strata.example.json) and context_length must not exceed its context_tokens. max_inflight 1: Strata runs one request at a time on 12 GB. read_timeout_s 600: a first turn after Strata's idle unload waits ~195 s for the load. The token file is unique to this node, never the Pro's.
ollama.label: PC
